observations.detail: PR #1282 adds exactly one file, entities/fa/fal.yaml, holding one new entity and one offer. The shard directory and file name both derive from the slug 'fal'. sha256 of the file as committed: 38d5266a21177a1bc2afe2c80eac0a45c32476ae4ff717425d76040951d488f3.

The only source cited is https://fal.ai/startup-program, a page on the vendor's own domain. Offer: $1,000 in fal credits on the Startup tier, the default entry point for approved teams. Eligibility: Proven traction or institutional VC backing; open to teams based in Europe and Asia.
Both required checks are green on the pull request head: 'sourcey/validation' success and 'validate catalog change' success. The commit carries a DCO Signed-off-by line matching the commit author.

The pinned Catalog Verifier was run locally before pushing: 'sourcey-catalog-verify validate startup-credits' reports 'Sourcey verification passed (entities: 1, programs: 0, offers: 1)' against the repository root set and the live parent release.
